newsitem.title: USA: Supervalu to keep 10 pct Cabot Noble shrs.
newsitem.headline: Supervalu to keep 10 pct Cabot Noble shrs.

text.p: Phar-Mor Inc said on Friday that Supervalu Inc agreed to retain 10 percent of the Cabot Noble common stock it would receive after Phar-Mor merged with ShopKo Stores Inc.
Phar-Mor and ShopKo said on September 9 they agreed to merge the two companies under a new holding company called Cabot Noble Inc in a deal valued at $1 billion.
Supervalu, which owned 46 percent of ShopKo common stock, would sell back its remaining Cabot Noble shares for about $223.6 million or $16.86 per ShopKo share, Phar-Mor said.
After the Cabot Noble repurchase, Supervalu would hold about six percent of Cabot Noble shares depending upon the exchange ratio, Phar-Mor said.
In a joint statement, Phar-Mor and ShopKo said they would close Phar-Mor's Youngstown, Ohio headquarters and centralize operations at a Green Bay, Wisconsin headquarters.
This consolidation was expected to occur in phases over the next six months.
ShopKo President and Chief Executive Officer Dale Kramer would become a member of Cabot's board of directors.
ShopKo is a retailer, operating 130 stores in 15 states with the retail drug store chain Phar-Mor operating 102 stores in 18 states.
The merger was expected to close in December, the companies said.
